spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Which site serves each workload, and what recovery evidence is missing?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/operations/grafana-dashboard-design.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Expected sites
spec.description: Declared inventory survives the disappearance of a source. This is expected scope, not health.

spec.title: Reporting sites
spec.description: A reporting site has fresh, successful evidence collection. Compare with expected sites; partial results never certify fleet health.

spec.title: Site evidence
spec.description: Measured site evidence, including explicit Unknown when an expected site stops reporting. Independent site probes distinguish unreachable from unobserved.

spec.title: Evidence age
spec.description: Age of the last successful Kubernetes inventory observation. A recent Prometheus scrape alone does not prove the collector is seeing its upstream.

spec.title: Ready nodes
spec.description: Ready nodes per Kubernetes cluster. These nested Talos nodes share the Windows/WSL host's physical CPU, RAM and disk.

spec.title: Cross-site observation
spec.description: Fresh bounded probes from one site to the other. Observer identity is retained; this is connectivity evidence, not the remote site's internal condition.

spec.title: Declared placement

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster, app, tier, kind, workload) (homelab_expected_workload_info{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})

spec.description: Expected app/site/tier inventory independent of discovery. Standbys and hardware-pinned applications remain visible.

spec.title: Desired replicas
spec.description: Effective workload desired replicas from the local Kubernetes API, separate from git's default placement.

spec.title: Ready replicas
spec.description: Observed readiness. Ready replicas do not prove the global ingress is serving this site.

spec.title: Runtime overrides present
spec.description: Presence of flux-system/site-overrides. Raw contents and secret-like values are never exposed.

spec.title: Override creation age
spec.description: Age of creation, not last modification. Consult structured operation events for when a particular override changed.

spec.title: Readiness evidence
spec.description: Unknown is retained whenever fencing, backup or restore evidence is absent. This is not a safe-to-promote guarantee.

spec.title: Fencing evidence age
spec.description: Present only for verified fence evidence. DNS ownership alone cannot establish that the former primary is unable to write.

spec.title: Last restore evidence
spec.description: Per-app restore evidence, not one successful fleet CronJob. Missing per-app results remain Unknown.

spec.title: Sites & Failover
spec.description: Which site serves each workload, and what recovery evidence is missing?
